idea: a reversal can lock two blocks face to face: each switch frees the block it must, but turns another toward a block that waits for it - fire it before that block has left and both are stuck; the gate decides who can leave first
redesign: round 1 (SG3) reached 2 distinct mistakes: its reversals only freed blocks; now each switch also turns a block toward a block that waits for it (an early switch is a deadlock)
